statement:
∀ (g g' h h' φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ) (a b c : ℝ),
  (∀ (x : ℝ), HasDerivAt g (g' x) x) →
    (∀ (x : ℝ), HasDerivAt h (h' x) x) →
      (∀ (x : ℝ), HasDerivAt φ (φ' x) x) →
        Continuous g' →
          Continuous h' →
            Continuous φ' →
              φ b = 0 →
                φ c = 0 →
                  -((∫ (x : ℝ) in b..a, g x * φ' x) + ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..c, h x * φ' x) =
                    ((∫ (x : ℝ) in b..a, g' x * φ x) + ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..c, h' x * φ x) + (h a - g a) * φ a
